structured_output.what_is_happening: FUNKOS ("pump.fun, but for AI agents", linked to X @funkosfun and funkos.fun) was launched through uxento and migrated to PumpSwap at the moment of creation (created time equals migration time), about 37 minutes before detection. It spiked to roughly $1.2M market cap (ATH price 0.00121). Then it crashed about 90% within five minutes and about 94% from its ATH, down to roughly $67-78k. The trigger fired because of volume from that crash: about $149k in volume and about 21k transactions, split close to evenly between about 2.5k unique buyers and 2.5k unique sellers. The packet also lists at least 9 other FUNKOS/funkos tokens launched in the past ~10 hours. Most now show zero liquidity. One, BDKC...funk (a vanity address), is still live with about $30k liquidity and predates this pair.

narrative.description: The pitch is a launchpad for AI agents, 'pump.fun for AI agents'. That is a recurring meta, and the project has a real-looking website and X handle. The flood of same-name copycats shows the name drew real interest today.
narrative.why_spreading: The name and concept drew attention, but the attention is now split across many clones. This pair's price action shows a blow-off top that has already happened (about $1.2M down to about $70k). This is exit activity, not accumulation.

token_connection.why_this_token: This pair carries the project's X handle and website in the GMGN/GeckoTerminal metadata, and it reached the highest ATH among the live copies. That suggests the market briefly treated it as the official token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name tokens. BDKC...funk is older, still live with about $29.9k liquidity and $19k of h1 volume, and has a vanity 'funk' address. HbgD... shows a $13.5M mcap with zero liquidity (stale or rugged). The rest are dead copies.

authenticity.evidence: The spread looks organic: 2.5k+ unique buyers, top10 at only 4.5%, bot/degen and fresh-wallet rates are low, and there is no paid DexScreener promotion. Against that: the coin was created and migrated instantly (bundled launch via uxento, 6 bundler wallets holding about 4.2%). The X account tied to the dev has launched 95 tokens. The logo is a duplicate of 4 other tokens. top_entrapment_trader_pct is 0.77, which is high. There were no smart or renowned wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see X posts, so I can't tell whether the team endorsed this contract or disowned it. The crash may have been an insider dump or a 'wrong CA' reveal.

structural_risks: Down about 94% from ATH, which leaves a large overhead of trapped holders who will sell into any bounce
The LP is burned, so liquidity can't be pulled, but the pair can bleed out to near-dead volume
Buy/sell counts are balanced, so there is no net demand
Liquidity of about $23k is thin against about $78k mcap
Heavy same-ticker competition splits the buyers
The X account linked to the dev launched 95 tokens, a serial-launcher pattern

structured_output.counterargument: The coin was already worth $1.2M 30 minutes ago and has thousands of holders, a real product pitch, a website and an X handle. If the team confirms this is the official contract, or the crash was a single whale exit, a dead-cat recovery to about $150k (only about 12% of ATH) is easily within reach. Burned LP also rules out a classic liquidity pull.
unknowns: Who caused the 90% dump (dev, bundlers or a whale)
Price path over the 25 minutes before entry
Whether the BDKC...funk copy is the real token

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; this judgment uses only the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a post-blow-off wreck: it went from $1.2M to about $70k in minutes, and the trigger fired on crash volume, not new demand. The name is contested by about 10 clones, the launch was bundled and instant-migrated, and the linked X account belongs to a serial launcher. A bounce to 2x from here is possible but unlikely before either the -50% stop or a slow death. Burned LP makes an outright liquidity pull less likely, but the pair dying is still quite possible.
